about_the_game:
In this High Intensity, Soul Crashing, Immensely Capturing, AA Batteries game, you're gonna play Pool with your friends, or alone, in a bar!

How can you achieve such grace, you may ask - Well through the power of stupid and funny gamemodes (and maybe a little bit of alcohol) you too can experience Pool games at the highest level.

Gather up to 3 of your friends and battle it out on a fair and square battlefield of mind games, determination and sheer will power. Whoever is able to harness the power of the physics engine the best will be victorious!

"The game is amazing, still don't got a girlfriend"

  • Me, the developer

Some gamemodes that are available to play:

  • Ice table - No friction necessary!

  • randomized balls' spawns, fun for the entire family!

  • Randomize hit angle - Go up to 180 degrees, try to beat that!

  • Be able to select all balls, Cause rules are for nerds and sabotaging is fun!

  • More/less balls rows - Go up to 10 rows (55 balls) for the most satisfying results!

  • Mix-And-Match all the options for a chaos experience that leaves everyone disappointed!

More features are to be added in the future. If you have any suggestions, feel free to contact me using email and I would be glad to listen.
